title: Algebraic immunity on a fixed Hamming layer
summary: Determine the least degree threshold at which a nonzero Boolean polynomial must vanish on a fixed Hamming layer of the Boolean cube.

formal_statement.body: For $1\le k\le n$, let $\Omega_{n,k}=\{x\in\mathbb F_2^n:\operatorname{wt}(x)=k\}$. Define $e(n,k)$ as the least degree $d$ for which there is a nonzero Boolean polynomial $g$ of degree at most $d$ whose evaluation is zero on every point of $\Omega_{n,k}$. Determine this sharp layer-restricted annihilator threshold, or equivalently the dimension threshold for restricted monomial evaluations.

assumptions: Inputs are restricted to one Hamming layer
scope.unresolved_remainder: The current public record concerns first-order/asymptotic information and does not assert a sharp constant-order formula.
